notes.title: An update on ctrl
notes.content: You can now use Q/E/Z/C as diagonal direction inputs. At the cost of that, you can only use WASD/JKUI layout now. The ZXCV/Arrow controls are disabled as there are no diagonal keys for them.

notes.title: Aug 10 - BugFix
notes.content: Fixed some bugs in Day4 that may lead player to unwanted regions.
